sum: Vylor Inc. operates as a seed and genetics company. It delivers a pipeline in the industry's elite germplasm and transformative sciences, such as biotechnology and gene editing. The company was founded in 1802 and is based in Johnston, Iowa.
ceo: Mr. Charles Victor Magro B.Sc. (Chem), MBA (CEO & Director)
